main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of 84-bar excess return (return minus coin's normal drift) on forecast
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 confirms (with supporting check), t <= -2 rejects, at least 200 cases

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of cases with forecast > 0

decided_by: The slope's t is between -2 and 2.
reading: The 200-case minimum is read as the number of pooled grid samples in the regression. Each coin's normal drift is its mean 84-bar return over the grid samples of all its windows. A grid bar whose 84-bar end falls outside its window is left out.
